title: What a sandboxed extension can open and run
steps: Boards, Word count and the html-app samples work as before: open Boards tour and move a card, and install Word count from the Catalog.
Make .common-ink/extensions/settings/extension.json holding {"name": "Test"} and reload: the Extensions view lists Test as Failed, and says why and what to do.
test/browser/sandbox-escape.browser.ts and test/browser/sandbox-namespace.browser.ts cover what a sandboxed extension can no longer open, run, name or bind.
